text:
I didn't write an issue for #11. I returned it as blocked, and the harness accepted that. The request only asks why mathlib uses CommonJS instead of ES modules. It doesn't ask for anything in the repository to change, so there's nothing to build or check, and it's better answered in the issue thread. I didn't look into the repository, so I can't say what the actual reason for the choice is.

If the person later wants a change, such as moving to ES modules or writing down why CommonJS was chosen, that would be a separate request and could become an issue.
